extracted.intended_audience: students/apprentice geometers / readers of classical practical geometry
extracted.subtask_description: Procedural rules and recipes for constructing and computing lengths/areas in circles, polygons, triangles and rectangles (inscribing polygons, arranging equal circles, computing diagonals/areas via multiplication and extraction of roots) from a historical Italian geometry text.

rubrics_metrics.name: Area of a rectangle
rubrics_metrics.description: La superficie ... multiplicando el largo per il longo.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Compute the area of a (rectangular) figure by multiplying its width (‘largo’) by its length (‘longo’). The text repeatedly uses this rule as the basic way to obtain surface (e.g., 'la superficie multiplicando el largo per lolongo').

rubrics_metrics.name: Diagonal (diameter) of rectangle via product and root
rubrics_metrics.description: Trova il diametro ... multiplica le parti e poi trai la radice; la diagonale si ricava dalla moltiplicazione delle dimensioni e dall'estrazione della radice.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: To find the diagonal (diameter) of a rectangle, form the sum/product-of-squares of the sides (the treatise describes multiplying sides and taking roots), then extract the square root to obtain the diagonal. (Text phrasing: 'poi troa la diagonale ... multiplicando el largo per lolongo ... giota al Diametro' and many passages about multiplication and taking 'radice').

rubrics_metrics.name: Squaring a triangle to find circle diameter (via subdivision)
rubrics_metrics.description: Per quadrar il triangolo e dedurre il diametro del cerchio: dal centro al toccamento dei lati condurre linee che dividono il triangolo in parti, quadrare quelle parti e ricondurre; il diametro si ottiene come radice di una quantità dedotta (es. 'radice di 720').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Procedure: from the center to each tangency draw lines dividing the triangle into several smaller triangles; square (compute areas of) those pieces, sum/multiply as directed, then take appropriate roots to find the diameter of the inscribed/circumscribed circle. The text gives numeric worked examples (e.g., 'radice di 72', 'radice di 720') showing how to reduce the area computations to a diameter by extracting roots.

rubrics_metrics.name: Placing equal circles inside a triangle (centers proportional to sides)
rubrics_metrics.description: Collocare cerchi uguali nel triangolo in modo che dai centri le linee siano proporzionali ai lati; i triangoli formati sono proporzionali ai lati del grande triangolo e da ciò si ricavano i diametri dei tondi.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Construct the small circles so that the lines joining their centers are parallel/proportional to the triangle's sides; because the small central triangles are proportional to the large triangle, diameters of the small circles are proportional to the corresponding sides and can be computed by multiplying/dividing lengths accordingly (the text: 'le linee ... fanno vno triangolo e Tonno equedilanti a li lati del triangolo grande... quelli triangoli fonno pjopositionali ... dibifogno trouare la perpendiculare ...').

rubrics_metrics.name: Inscribing a regular hexagon by successive radii (Euclidean method)
rubrics_metrics.description: Nel cerchio collocare vno esagono: la costruzione si ottiene collocando 6 triangoli equilateri; il lato dell'esagono coincide con il raggio/semidiametro (Euclideo).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use six equal equilateral triangles around the center: successive radii produce the hexagon's vertices; the side of the regular hexagon equals the circle's radius/semidiameter. The text references Euclid as justification and shows how to place six equal circles or triangles ('come dice Euclideo ... il lato del esagono e il diametro del circlo alquale...').

rubrics_metrics.name: Relation for regular pentagon side vs diameter (root expressions)
rubrics_metrics.description: Quando il diametro del tondo fosse 4 volte il lato del pentagono si possono esprimere i rapporti colla radice di certe quantità (es. 'radice di 20'); la relazione fra quadrato del diametro e del lato del pentagono si ricava e si usa per trovare la misura.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: To find the side of a regular pentagon from the circle diameter, form the algebraic relation between the square of the diameter and the square of the pentagon side and manipulate by subtracting/computing roots (the text invokes a Ptolemaic-type relation: 'quando el diametro del tondo folse.4.ellato del pentagono... la radice di quella linea...'). Worked numeric manipulations (square, subtract, take roots) are shown.

rubrics_metrics.name: Constructing a regular octagon from diameter (root/division recipe)
rubrics_metrics.description: Per mettere un ottagono in un cerchio di diametro dato: moltiplica il diametro per certe quantità, prendi metà e radici successive, suddividi e moltiplica per ottenere il lato; l'ottagono si ottiene mediante quadrati, radici e divisioni.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Procedure consists of algebraic operations on the given diameter: multiply by constants, take halves/roots (radici), divide into equal parts and recompose to produce the side length of the regular octagon. The text presents stepwise numeric recipes: 'multiplicarai il diametro ... la mita e.2.c radici di.2... la radice ... moltiplica ...' and several worked sequences.

rubrics_metrics.name: Packing 4 equal circles inside a big circle (square arrangement)
rubrics_metrics.description: Per collocare 4 cerchi uguali dentro un cerchio grande segnato su un quadrato: i diametri dei piccoli tondi si ottengono dai confronti fra diametro del grande e diametro del quadrato; il diametro del piccolo vale radice(2* quantità) (esempi numerici nel testo).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Arrange the four small circles with centers at the corners/centers of a square inscribed in the big circle; derive the small diameter by algebraic reduction involving the big diameter and the square's diagonal (example: 'il diametro duno de i ditti tondi fia vna cofa ... per che il fuo diametro fia radice di 2 . cenfi ...').

rubrics_metrics.name: General method: inscribe n equal tangent circles by dividing circumference
rubrics_metrics.description: Per collocare n cerchi uguali che siano contigenti entro un cerchio grande: menando da centri le linee parallele alle contiguità si ottiene un poligono regolare di n lati; dividere la circonferenza in n parti uguali e ricavare i diametri per proporzione.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Divide the circumference into n equal arcs; join centers to form a regular n-gon similar to triangles on the sides; by proportionality deduce the diameters of the small circles from the sides of that polygon (text: 'totti i ditti tondi contengenn l'un l'altro fanno tale natura che menando da centri le linee ... farebbono vno pentagono... dimostrarremo...').

rubrics_metrics.name: Compute area of an inscribed polygon by summing component triangle areas
rubrics_metrics.description: La area dell'intero poligono (o del triangolo grande con figure dentro) si ottiene quadrando e sommando tutte le figure interne (triangoli, quadrangoli) e riducendo le unità; il testo usa la moltiplicazione del diametro per somme di facce interne per ottenere l'area.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Procedure: divide the polygon/triangle into component triangles/quadrilaterals (via radii, tangency, perpendiculars), compute each area (often by multiplying base by height or using squares/radices), sum them and perform unit reductions (cofa/cento etc.). The treatise repeatedly instructs 'quadrare tutte le figure che sono nel detto triangolo' then combine to find total area, sometimes multiplying the diameter by a computed face-sum.

rubrics_metrics.name: Perpendicular length via multiplication and root extraction
rubrics_metrics.description: Per trovare una perpendicolare occorre moltiplicare certi segmenti e poi trarne la radice; la perpendicolare risulta come radice della differenza/combinatione di quadrati prodotti (es. 'multiplica m.r. in fe fanno 4.cenfi e dopoi multiplica m.r. in fe fanno vno cenfo... la radice vna cofa ... tanto e la perpendiculare').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When a perpendicular is required (e.g., from a vertex to a base in triangular decompositions), the method is to compute specified products of known sides (often using the unit 'cofa' and centesimal arithmetic), reduce by subtraction or halving as directed, then take the square root to obtain the perpendicular length. The text gives explicit numeric sequences.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use and conversion of units ('cofa', 'cenfo') in area/length computations
rubrics_metrics.description: The treatise consistently expresses areas and lengths in old units like 'cofa' and 'cenfo' and prescribes converting, multiplying and subtracting these units in multi-step arithmetic before taking roots.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow the book's unit-handling recipes: multiply given measures in 'cofa' units, reduce/rebase sums to a single unit (e.g., convert to 'vno cenfo'), subtract or add intermediate results, then take roots. Many worked examples show conversion steps (e.g., 'vna cofa e vno fanno vno cenfo e.2.cofe', 'moltiplica ... fanno 2.cenfi ... radice di ...').
